speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following a recent course of antibiotics for acute sinusitis. To help me understand your condition better, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as color, smell, or frequency, or do you have burning sensations when you urinate?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Since your fatigue and flank pain persisted despite the improvement of your sinus symptoms, could you describe the appearance of your urine, specifically if it looks cloudy, reddish, or if you notice any foul odor?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That reaction to amoxicillin followed by improvement on cephalexin is concerning for a drug allergy, but given your specific symptoms of fever and flank pain, I need to know if the pain radiates to your groin or if you have seen any blood in your urine.
